A2.5 Conceptualisation was considered for the bulletin-cluster comparison, but the officer's dominant behavior in that episode is generating and adjusting a course of action (planning) rather than forming an abstract diagnostic model, so A2.6 was prioritized as primary over A2.5.

task_anchors.task_description: Officer monitors ARPA targets and cross-checks with visual sweeps at watch handover, detecting a poorly radar-visible fishing boat visually before ARPA acquisition.
Officer weighs reliance on ARPA's automated prioritization versus manual visual sweeps for a weakly-tracked small contact.
Officer decides to continue monitoring rather than take early avoiding action for an erratically-moving contact, based on ARPA's non-escalated ranking and failed VHF contact.

Officer allocates attention and plans an evasive course amid a squall, a fishing cluster resembling a recalled incident, and a bulk carrier with tightening CPA, then reprioritizes toward the bulk carrier.
Officer briefs the master and recommends posting an additional lookout for the remainder of the transit based on observed fishing activity.
